Sam: Heads-up, I'm onboarding open-llama-v2-13B to staging. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/open-llama-v2/13b/release-2026-03-15. Noticed tokenizer behavior that can break our chat templates: it looks like the model/tokenizer pair is inserting a BOS token on encode, which our preprocess also used to add.
Anya: Which tokenizer implementation is that — HF tokenizers or our shim?
Sam: It's the HF tokenizer bundle included in the release bucket (there's a tokenizer.json next to the weights). Quick repro locally shows an extra leading token.
Cheng: I ran the formatting tests and saw off-by-one token indices in chat messages. Repro snippet I used:
```
# simplified example
# HF tokenizer encodes "Hello" -> [1, 72, 345, 2]  # 1=BOS, 2=EOS
# our preprocess expected -> [72, 345, 2]
# result: system/user role tokens get shifted by 1
```
Liz: That will break our prompt-mapping and evals. Two ways to handle: (A) normalize in our token loader (strip leading BOS if present), or (B) add a tokenizer_config flag like "add_bos": false and rely on a consistent policy. I prefer (A) as a short-term compatibility shim.
Sam: Agreed. I'll add a normalization step in `serving/preprocess.py` — detect leading BOS id based on tokenizer.special_tokens_map and drop it for chat inputs, plus a feature flag.
Anya: Also FYI the tokenizer bundle in that S3 path has a `special_tokens_map.json` that maps `` to `<|endoftext|>` in some variants. That renaming causes our chat formatter to not find the expected token and append an extra EOS. We should canonicalize names during loader.
Cheng: I've prepared a pytest snippet to catch both cases (extra BOS and renamed EOS). I'll push to `tokenizer-compat-tests` branch in a sec. Test does: encode(chat_template) -> assert token indices align with `role_offsets` table.
Sam: Please @ me on the PR. I'll implement the loader change and update the default chat templates to not include an explicit BOS token. Also will add a regression test. :eyes:
Liz: Ping me for review once PR is up. Make sure to update `docs/serving/tokenizer.md` with the policy (how we treat model-added BOS/EOS) so oncall doesn't get bitten in prod.
ci-bot: build queued for branch tokenizer-compat-tests (commit 7c3a1d). Running unit tests.
Cheng: Quick note — we should also add a small e2e in staging that runs a short chat convo through the runtime (batch size 1) to verify logits align with local decode after normalization.
Sam: Good call, will add a staging job that runs post-deploy smoke test for the new weights.
Anya: Thanks team — sounds like a short actionable plan: (1) Sam adds loader normalization + docs, (2) Cheng pushes tests, (3) Liz reviews PR, (4) CI/e2e runs on staging.
Liz: I'll schedule a quick follow-up async review window tomorrow.
